improvements.title: Fix native command-line quoting
improvements.assessment: Native argument echo demonstrates exact argument-vector round trips in both shells; actual PDFtk/GS path tests characterize supported special characters and explicit safe backend failures. T23 reruns both evidence classes separately.

improvements.title: Harden folder handling and batch launcher
improvements.assessment: Actual entry-point discovery and cmd/BAT tests retain one top-level folder, uppercase PDF inclusion, hidden/subfolder policy, quoted paths, 0/1/2 status propagation and pause. Percent expansion is a documented cmd boundary; original BAT uses PS5.1. No Explorer pass inferred.

improvements.title: Make natural sorting dependable
improvements.assessment: Comparator regressions exercise ASCII digit runs, leading/all-zero tokens, long magnitudes, multiple segments/cultures/ties; actual independent PDFium observations confirm final page order and rotation. T29 exact packages demonstrate 1,01,2,10,20 with visible identifiers.

improvements.title: Make output creation non-destructive
improvements.assessment: Actual native/filesystem tests and controlled fault scheduling cover owned staging, existing outputs/source hashes, overlap/junction refusal, concurrency, safe cleanup and interruption. T29 package/source/foreign/tree guards pass in all 25 scenarios.

improvements.title: Validate PDFs, not only existence
improvements.assessment: Actual PDFtk preflight inventories real pages; malformed/encrypted/non-PDF data fail. Controlled exit-zero invalid-output cases establish state gates while actual merged/native/email outputs have independent counts/order. T29 inspects 21 package-produced PDFs/106 pages.

improvements.title: Strengthen process execution and cleanup
improvements.assessment: Controlled native executables cover stream volume, launch failures and bounded owned termination; real engines establish noninteractive selected command operation. GS_OPTIONS restoration, master retention, ownership cleanup and IO/log fault classes stay explicit; simulated faults are not real resource exhaustion.

improvements.title: Repair dependency discovery
improvements.assessment: Executable selection/fallback/probe tests distinguish controlled fixtures from genuine engines; T25 runtime/dependency/privacy reviews preserve optional GS, dated vendor pins, unsigned disclosure and no silent install/network. T29 actual absent-GS/master-only scenario passes.

improvements.title: Report partial success accurately
improvements.assessment: Native outcomes and fault injections prove full/master-only/partial result states. T29 genuine unchanged-GS initialization failure returns application/BAT 2 in three cases, retains validated masters and publishes no failed email.

improvements.title: Detect practical limits before starting
improvements.assessment: Serialized command-length and path/output preflights fail before unsafe work. T23 actual 138-input/29475-character merge succeeds; 180-input/38337-character vector is refused with unchanged files. Timings are modest synthetic observations, not throughput/resource guarantees.

improvements.title: Add a small useful parameter set
improvements.assessment: Actual binding/CLI/native defaults and options preserve /screen and output beside scripts; invalid options fail before output, explicit skip avoids GS and explains ignored presets. T29 public extracted-package scenarios recheck those outcomes.

improvements.title: Make compression results informative
improvements.assessment: Measured sizes/reduction and equal/larger candidate disposition are tested; retained T17 assistant visual inspection covers synthetic small-print/scan/mixed fixtures. AC041 pass is expressly scoped assistant visual QA, not human/Explorer AC058. T29 decoded-image review confirms smaller screen/ebook rewrites with distinct raster behavior.

improvements.title: Narrow preservation claims
improvements.assessment: Native synthetic feature characterization separates master/email visual and structural observations; public docs disclose forms/tags/attachments/signatures/PDF-A/archival/malware limits. No universal fidelity or archive-safety promise is supported.

improvements.title: Improve diagnostics and help
improvements.assessment: Actual documentation/help invocations and controlled summary tests record selected versions, stages, streams, order/pages/sizes and true outputs; T27 rechecks startup/log VERSION and T29 rechecks both extracted-package help calls. Logs remain local/confidential.

improvements.title: Small internal changes for testability
improvements.assessment: Import-safety unit tests show helper loading has no merge/exit/GS_OPTIONS/publication side effects; small helper boundaries and controlled-native fixture tests remain separate from original synthetic PDFtk fixture evidence. Runtime remains PowerShell/PDFtk with optional GS.

improvements.title: Automated and Windows acceptance tests
improvements.assessment: T23 both actual required shells pass 29 separately classified tiers/58 pairs; T21/T22 corpus/fault/static work and T29 exact candidate operation support scoped coverage. D25 explicitly excludes human AC058; Windows10/liveUNC/ARM/32-bit scopes are nonrequired exclusions, never passes.

Current matching-head check/review remains T30; accepted-main/final-commit AC071/072 are T31 gates.
